claims.statement: Tom Allen was a guest, with Prof. Bauer, Andre Christol and Leon Schuler, at a breakfast given by the French caterer Jean Bonnet in St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: Signor Andre Christol, Tom Allen and Mr. Leon Schuler, were yesterday the gucsts

claims.statement: Bauer said he would return to St. Louis and make a match with Julius Schroeder once Tom Allen notified him that a suitable deposit had been posted.
claims.excerpt: a suitable deposit has been posted he will return to St. Louis and make the match

notes: Allen appears as a guest and as Bauer's friend and go-between; the Schroeder challenge itself concerns Bauer, not Allen.
